name: 83706 · Boise, ID
findings: ZIP 83706 (Boise) has 157 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83706 (Boise) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
